import nanosurf
import time

#load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # or .C3000() or .CX(), or .CoreAFM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Start scan
# scan.StartFrameDown() #Scanning from up to down or top to bottom
scan.StartFrameUp() #Scanning from down to up or bottom to top

#scan.stop() #stop sacn
scanning = scan.IsScanning # Check if scanning
while scanning:
        print("Scanning in progress... Remaining lines:",(scan.Lines-scan.Currentline))
        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print('Setting operating mode to Contact mode...')
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

print('Setting PID gains...')
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

print('Setting scan parameters...')
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Calculate time per line: 154 seconds total / (3 scans * 128 lines) = 0.401 seconds
scan.Scantime = 0.401  # seconds per line

print('Scan parameters set:')
print(f'  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm')
print(f'  Points per line: {scan.Points}')
print(f'  Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}')
print(f'  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s')
print(f'  Estimated time per scan: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines:.1f} s')
print(f'  Estimated total time for 3 scans: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines * 3:.1f} s')

del spm
